integrity: A complete analytical proof is accompanied by an exact-rational finite diagnostic, which does not substitute for independent review.
limitations: Finite real paths only; exactly two output color classes; all vertex masses and variation-edge weights strictly positive. Upper mass-design envelope is nonattained except in the constant-one case. Historical-priority risk for unindexed equivalents remains.
title: Exact variation-norm mass design for two-color conditional expectations on weighted paths
